gaps.sentence: He's not very friendly ___ his new colleagues.
gaps.explanation: friendly WITH somebody = on good terms; a friendly person is friendly TO others.

gaps.sentence: Is there any excuse ___ being so rude?

gaps.explanation: shout AT somebody = be aggressive; shout TO = call so they hear.

gaps.sentence: His attitude ___ work has really improved.
You should concentrate ___ one task at a time.
Have you paid ___ the tickets yet?
gaps.explanation: pay FOR goods/services; pay a bill (no preposition).

gaps.sentence: I haven't heard ___ my cousin since Christmas.
gaps.explanation: hear FROM somebody = get a letter/message from them.
